# Agilis Software

> > Agilis Software provides sophisticated software licensing and license management solutions through its Orion Network Licensing Platform, serving enterprises, ISVs, and embedded systems manufacturers.

Agilis Software specializes in comprehensive software licensing and monetization solutions. The Orion platform supports diverse licensing models, deployment options, and industry-specific use cases including cloud licensing, enterprise licensing, embedded systems, and hardware subscriptions.
